archetypes.name: autofix-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Checks the empty-plan no-dispatch boundary and emitted KVs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan auto-fix entrypoint for control-flow correctness around invalid, empty, and valid plan files. Confirm the empty-target path cannot initialize vendor dispatch side effects and still matches existing no-dispatch output conventions. Check whether the guard ordering preserves existing rejection behavior for paths outside the design tmpdir. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step5c-doc-drift
archetypes.rationale: Reviews the Step 5c prose against actual wrapper and publish semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the updated Step 5c documentation with the design-step5c and design-publish behavior. Focus on whether Override, Fix-and-retry, autofix-success, and missing-or-empty composed-plan paths are described without overgeneralizing --skip-validate. Flag any remaining prose that could recreate the drift fixed here. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
